batch: Run-state retention implementation and focused regression

implementation.eligibleRecords: Only old, valid run manifests whose operation progress uniquely matches operation IDs and is entirely Completed or AlreadyDesired.
implementation.recoveryEffect: Approved cleanup permanently removes saved run snapshots and file backups and prevents RIDE restore for that run.

verification.scope: Synthetic Pester TestDrive stores only; includes preview without deletion, approved deletion, preservation of recent/failed/unfinished/malformed records, and elevation gating.
verification.parser: Engine module, CLI and focused test file parsed without errors in PowerShell 7.6.5.
verification.cliHelp: prune-state and its scope/age parameters appear in CLI help.

aclReview.sourceFinding: Machine state-root ACL is protected and grants SYSTEM and local Administrators full control; child files inherit. User state inherits Local AppData ACL.
aclReview.deferred: Inspect effective user and machine ACLs on disposable Windows targets.
